criteria.statement: Bahia resolves the complete fleet-configured service dependency set to immutable lowercase 40-hex commits and emits one exact dep tag per dependency.
Any missing or unresolvable dependency prevents workflow-run and Loom job publication without a partial dependency set.
Floating revisions, non-HTTPS URLs, userinfo, query credentials, fragments, foreign Gitea origins, and forged generic dep params are rejected before publication without leaking secrets.
Capability-gated worker selection, encrypted mirror-read credential delivery, no-payment behavior, the kind-5401 contract, and exact replay deduplication remain unchanged.
